name: Bounce lobber
description: a hunched grey-brown demon of the Cracked Road crouched on a spire ledge with long arms, cradling a glowing ball of magma in both hands, rubbery limbs

poses.stand: crouched on a ledge cradling a glowing ball of magma, facing right
poses.struck: struck: recoiling, the magma ball wobbling in its hands
poses.dead: slumped over, the magma ball rolled away and cooling

idle.action: breathes and shifts in place, glow pulsing slowly

attack.action: performs its signature attack toward the right, glow flaring

hurt.action: is struck, jerks back, then settles

die.action: flares bright, breaks apart in a burst of embers and goes still
